entries: **Heart Monitor panel theme.** A hospital-monitor look on a dark grid: every quota row scrolls an ECG trace whose peaks grow taller and faster as usage rises, next to a large monospace readout. The 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the 80% mark still apply, and the animation stops when Reduce Motion is on. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 16.

Size the Windows panel from the scale its page is really rendered at, so it no longer scrolls when Windows' "Text size" is not 100% (a follow-up to [#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). Text size multiplies WebView2's device pixel ratio on top of the display scale (125% × 109% = 1.3625), but `GetDpiForWindow` does not include it, so a window sized with the display scale alone came out about 8% shorter than its content: a scrollbar appeared although the screen had room to spare, and hiding a card did not help. The panel page now reports its `devicePixelRatio` together with its content height, and the window size, work area, saved position and legibility floor are converted with it, falling back to the display scale until the page has reported one. pywebview's `resize()` / `move()` multiply by the display scale themselves, so they are corrected by the ratio between the two.

title.zh-TW: 心電圖面板主題登場，用量高低化為即時跳動波形

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板視窗精準貼合內容，放大文字不再冒出多餘捲軸
title.en: Windows popover window fits content accurately, eliminating unwanted scrollbars when scaling text

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Windows 調大文字大小，開啟面板不會再看到擠在邊緣的垂直捲軸。⟦照片接連放大兩次，若相框只照第一次尺寸做，邊緣仍會被擠住；按最後尺寸做才裝得下。⟧這是先前視窗問題（[#153]）的後續改進。若 Windows「文字大小」非 100%，會在顯示縮放外疊加 WebView2 縮放倍率（如 125% 乘 109% 達 1.3625）。舊版 `GetDpiForWindow` 未計入這層放大，使視窗比內容矮約 8% 而冒出捲軸，隱藏卡片也沒用。現在頁面會回報內容高度與 `devicePixelRatio`（實際顯示倍率），面板依此換算視窗大小、工作區、已存位置與可讀性下限，未回報前則退回顯示縮放。針對 pywebview 呼叫 `resize()` 與 `move()` 重複乘上縮放的問題，也依兩者比值補正。
body.en: When you increase text size on Windows, opening the popover will no longer display a vertical scrollbar crammed against the edge. ⟦When a photo is enlarged twice in succession, building the frame based only on the first resize still cramps the edges; only sizing it for the final dimensions makes everything fit.⟧ This is a follow-up improvement to a previous window issue ([#153]). If Windows "Text size" is not 100%, WebView2 zoom is compounded on top of display scaling, such as 125% multiplied by 109% reaching 1.3625. The legacy `GetDpiForWindow` did not account for this extra scaling layer, leaving the window roughly 8% shorter than its content and causing scrollbars to appear even if cards were hidden. The page now reports content height and `devicePixelRatio` (effective display scale), which the popover uses to calculate window dimensions, workspace, saved positions, and readability floors, falling back to display scale before reporting occurs. To address pywebview redundantly multiplying scaling on `resize()` and `move()` calls, values are corrected using the ratio between both scales.

The panel page now reports its `devicePixelRatio` together with its content height, and the window size, work area, saved position and legibility floor are converted with it, falling back to the display scale until the page has reported one. pywebview's `resize()` / `move()` multiply by the display scale themselves, so they are corrected by the ratio between the two.

entries: **Sketchbook panel theme.** A hand-drawn notebook look on grid paper: every quota shows as a half-circle gauge with a needle, the percentage sits in large ink over a highlighter stroke in each provider's color, and the 50% / 80% warning and danger colors and the fixed 80% mark still apply. Available on macOS and Windows; the panel count is now 15.

Keep the whole Windows panel on screen on short high-DPI displays, so the Refresh Now and Quit buttons are no longer cut off ([#153](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/153)). The panel now reads the target monitor's work area straight from Windows instead of relying on the screen size pywebview reports, sizes the zoom and the window from the same monitor, never lets the window's bottom edge pass the taskbar, and becomes scrollable if even the smallest readable zoom cannot fit.

Date Antigravity turns by their own time again. Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 and later no longer store a per-turn time where usage read it, so every turn of a multi-day conversation landed on the day it started. Turn times now come from the conversation's steps table, and the local caches are rebuilt once so older dates are recomputed.

Stop panel height and automatic zoom from repeatedly adjusting each other on macOS, which could make Origami jitter. Keep a conservative height during zoom-only fitting while allowing changed content to shrink, and cover automatic-fit stability and content transitions in the browser regression.

body.zh-TW: 平常盯著制式數據介面覺得單調時，現在能換上更有手感的新樣式來掌握用量。這次新增的手繪筆記（Sketchbook）面板主題，將方格紙質感搬上螢幕。介面把每個額度（quota，各家服務分配的使用上限）畫成帶指針的半圓儀表，並以深墨色大字搭配代表色螢光筆底線標示百分比。既有的 50% 與 80% 警示配色與固定的 80% 記號完全保留，macOS 與 Windows 都支援，讓面板總數來到 15 款。⟦好比隨手翻開手繪帳本，以前只見到整排冷冰冰的規格數據，現在每筆紀錄都像用麥克筆畫上刻度與底線，一眼就能看清進度。⟧

title.en: Full Windows Popover Display Prevents Bottom Action Buttons from Being Clipped

body.zh-TW: 在直向高度較矮的高解析度螢幕上使用 Windows 版，再也不必煩惱底部按鈕被擠出畫面外。以前面板仰賴 pywebview（負責在桌面呈現網頁介面的工具庫）回報的尺寸，容易算錯空間，導致「立即更新」與「結束」按鈕被切掉。現在面板直接向 Windows 讀取目標螢幕扣掉工作列後的可用範圍，縮放比例與視窗大小也改用同一個螢幕計算，視窗底邊絕不超過工作列。即使縮到最小可讀比例仍放不下，面板也會自動轉成可以捲動瀏覽。⟦如同依照牆面高度調整的展示架，以前只顧著展開而把底層按鈕擠到地板下，現在先扣除邊界空間並支援捲動，讓所有操作隨時都能點得到。⟧
body.en: When using the Windows version on high-resolution displays with shorter vertical heights, you no longer have to worry about bottom buttons being pushed offscreen. Previously, the popover relied on dimensions reported by pywebview (a library that renders web interfaces on the desktop), which often miscalculated space and cut off the "Update Now" and "Quit" buttons. Now, the popover directly queries Windows for the available area on the target display excluding the taskbar, and both the scale factor and window size are calculated from that same display so the bottom edge never exceeds the taskbar. Even if content cannot fit at the minimum readable scale, the popover automatically switches to a scrollable view. ⟦Think of a display rack tailored to wall height: instead of expanding blindly and pushing lower shelves under the floor, it accounts for boundary margins first and supports scrolling so every control stays within reach.⟧

The panel now reads the target monitor's work area straight from Windows instead of relying on the screen size pywebview reports, sizes the zoom and the window from the same monitor, never lets the window's bottom edge pass the taskbar, and becomes scrollable if even the smallest readable zoom cannot fit.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 跨天對話每輪各自計日，日期分佈更精準
title.en: Antigravity Multi-Day Chats Track Turns Daily for Accurate Date Distribution

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓同一個 AI 對話跨好幾天持續進行，用量圖表現在能如實呈現每天的真實消耗。從 Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 開始，系統不再把每輪對話時間存在原本的位置，導致跨天交談的每一輪用量全被歸到對話開始的第一天。現在程式改從對話的 steps（記錄每一步互動細節的資料表）讀取每輪時間。系統同時會主動重建一次本機快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用的機制），讓過去受影響的歷史日期全部重新計算校正。⟦跟逐日核銷費用的記帳本一樣，以前跨天出差只要寫在同一張申請單，所有花費全被算在出發第一天；現在改依每張明細的確切時間分別記帳，舊帳目也一併重新整理歸位。⟧
body.en: If you regularly keep the same AI conversation running over multiple days, usage charts now accurately reflect daily consumption. Starting with Antigravity CLI 1.1.18, the system no longer stores turn timestamps in their original location, which previously caused all usage across multi-day chats to be attributed to the first day. The application now reads individual turn timestamps from conversation steps (a table recording details for each interaction step). The system also proactively rebuilds the local cache once, recalculating and correcting all affected historical dates. ⟦Like a daily expense ledger where multi-day business trips used to dump every receipt onto the departure date on a single claim, expenses are now booked by the exact time of each item while older records are reconciled into place.⟧

Antigravity CLI 1.1.18 and later no longer store a per-turn time where usage read it, so every turn of a multi-day conversation landed on the day it started. Turn times now come from the conversation's steps table, and the local caches are rebuilt once so older dates are recomputed.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 摺紙主題抖動，面板縮放不再反覆拉扯
title.en: Fix macOS Origami Theme Jitter to Stop Popover Scaling Conflicts

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上選用摺紙風格面板時，介面不再因為尺寸計算打架而產生惱人的微小震顫。以前 macOS 上的面板高度與自動縮放機制會反覆互相觸發，導致 Origami（摺紙主題）介面持續抖動。現在程式在單純調整縮放時會保留足夠的高度空間，同時確保內容增減時依然能正常縮小。開發團隊也補上了瀏覽器回歸測試（browser regression，用自動化腳本驗證既有功能未被改壞的測試），涵蓋自動調整的穩定性與內容切換。⟦就像相機自動對焦找到穩定焦距，以前視窗與縮放比例互相干擾導致畫面不斷抽搐，現在設定好適當緩衝，既能隨內容靈活伸縮又不再無故晃動。⟧
body.en: When selecting the origami-style popover on a Mac, the interface no longer suffers from annoying micro-jitters caused by competing size calculations. Previously on macOS, popover height and automatic scaling repeatedly triggered each other, causing the Origami theme interface to jitter continuously. Now, the application preserves sufficient height headroom during pure scale adjustments while ensuring it can still shrink properly as content changes. The development team also added browser regression tests (automated scripts that verify existing features remain unbroken), covering auto-fit stability and content switching. ⟦Just as camera autofocus locks onto a stable focal length, where window sizing and scale factors once interfered and caused constant screen twitching, proper buffer spacing now allows smooth resizing with content without unprovoked shaking.⟧

items.original: Stop panel height and automatic zoom from repeatedly adjusting each other on macOS, which could make Origami jitter. Keep a conservative height during zoom-only fitting while allowing changed content to shrink, and cover automatic-fit stability and content transitions in the browser regression.

entries: **Dispatch ledger in the HTML report.** The top-conversations table gains an "Approx. weekly quota" column, and a new "Dispatch ledger (last 7 days)" section matches the `codex exec` / `agy -p` calls in a Claude conversation to the Codex and Antigravity conversations they started, estimating how much of each provider's weekly quota one task used: conversation tokens (excluding cache reads) ÷ the period's total tokens × that provider's weekly quota used. A dispatch is attributed by Claude's conversation UUID first, then by a -5 to +120 second time window, then by working directory; if it is still ambiguous it stays unattributed. It reads local files only — Antigravity's quota comes from the existing cache, with no new network call — and the section is omitted when there were no dispatches.
Tagging a release now also publishes `usage-cli` to PyPI through Trusted Publishing, with no stored token.

Keep footer action labels and buttons visible in the ten affected panel themes when the status-line setup button is shown, including narrow panels and longer translations. Allow local wrapping and natural button height while preserving theme chrome. Measure content at the displayed zoom so WebKit font metrics and line wrapping cannot clip the footer after panel scaling ([#151](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/151)).

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表新增派工帳本，清楚看懂跨工具額度消耗
title.en: HTML Reports Add Delegation Ledger to Track Multi-Tool Quota Consumption

body.zh-TW: 當你讓 Claude 呼叫其他工具一起分工寫程式時，往往很難算清一項任務到底扣了哪一邊的用量。⟦像工程主管核對跨包商工單，以前只見到月底整筆總支出，現在能清清楚楚拆解出每個專案各自攤提了哪家廠商的工時。⟧現在 HTML 報表的最耗用對話清單新增了「約佔週額度」欄位，並加入「派工帳本（最近 7 天）」區塊。它會將對話中的 `codex exec` 與 `agy -p` 呼叫，對應回 Codex 與 Antigravity 的紀錄。消耗估算是以對話消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）佔比，乘以各平台已使用的週額度。計算時會自動排除快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用）讀取的份額。歸屬依序比對對話識別碼、負五至一百二十秒的時間窗與工作目錄；若仍無法確認，就保持未歸屬。全程只讀取本機檔案與既有快取，不發送額外網路請求，沒有派工時也不會顯示此區塊。
body.en: When you have Claude delegate coding tasks to external tools, tracking which platform consumed quota for a specific task can be difficult. ⟦Think of an engineering manager auditing contractor invoices: where they once saw only a lump-sum bill at month-end, they can now clearly break down which vendor's hours were billed to each project.⟧ The top-spending conversations list in the HTML report now adds an "Est. % of Weekly Quota" column and introduces a "Delegation Ledger (Last 7 Days)" section. It maps `codex exec` and `agy -p` invocations within conversations back to Codex and Antigravity records. Usage estimation multiplies the conversation's token consumption share by each platform's used weekly quota. The calculation automatically excludes cached reads. Attribution matches sequentially by conversation ID, a time window of -5 to 120 seconds, and working directory; if it still cannot be confirmed, it remains unassigned. The entire process reads only local files and existing caches without making additional network requests, and the section is hidden when no delegation occurred.

title.zh-TW: 發行版本自動上傳套件庫，免存認證金鑰更安全
title.en: Automated Releases Upload to Package Index Without Storing Authentication Keys

body.zh-TW: 想要把維護好的工具打包發布，現在只要為專案建立版本標籤，流程就會透過受信任發布機制（Trusted Publishing，透過平台互信驗證身分的安全機制）自動將 `usage-cli` 送上 Python 套件庫 PyPI。⟦好比大樓改用身分認證自動辨識進出，以前必須在管理室押一把實體備用鑰匙，現在通過驗證就直接放行，櫃子裡不必保存任何密碼鑰匙。⟧整個自動化發布流程完全不需要在設定中存放任何 token（授權令牌），只要打上標籤發版就能安全完成發布，不必擔心金鑰外洩。
body.en: When publishing maintained tools, creating a version tag on the project will now automatically upload `usage-cli` to the Python package index PyPI via Trusted Publishing, a mechanism that verifies identity through trust between platforms. ⟦Picture a secure building switching to automated identity verification: instead of leaving a physical spare key with the front desk, visitors are granted entry directly upon authentication without storing any keys or combinations in a locker.⟧ The entire automated release workflow eliminates the need to store authorization tokens in settings. Tagging a release safely completes deployment without the risk of credential leakage.

items.original: Tagging a release now also publishes `usage-cli` to PyPI through Trusted Publishing, with no stored token.

title.zh-TW: 面板底部按鈕不再被裁切，窄版介面完整顯示操作文字
title.en: Popover Bottom Buttons No Longer Clipped Across Narrow Layouts

body.zh-TW: 當你在使用較窄的面板主題或是切換到文字較長的語言介面時，可能會發現底部的操作按鈕被切掉半截。⟦如同排版軟體依照實際縮放比例重新測量元件，以前視窗縮放後，邊界文字會被擠出畫面；現在文字可就地換行，按鈕高度也會自然調整，字樣不再被切掉。⟧這次修正解決了十款面板主題在顯示狀態列（顯示在終端機最底部的即時資訊列）設定按鈕時，底部標籤與按鈕溢出的問題。介面現在會依實際縮放比例精確測量內容，避免 WebKit 引擎縮放後的字體差異造成底部被截斷，同時保留各主題原本的外觀風格。
body.en: When using a narrow popover theme or switching to a language with longer text strings, you might find the bottom action buttons cut off. ⟦Like publishing software remeasuring elements against the actual zoom scale, where window resizing previously pushed edge text off-screen, text now wraps in place while button heights adjust naturally so labels are never clipped.⟧ This fix resolves bottom label and button overflow across 10 popover themes when displaying status line settings buttons. The interface now accurately measures content based on the actual scale factor, preventing font rendering discrepancies in the WebKit engine from truncating the bottom while preserving each theme's original visual styling.

items.original: Keep footer action labels and buttons visible in the ten affected panel themes when the status-line setup button is shown, including narrow panels and longer translations. Allow local wrapping and natural button height while preserving theme chrome. Measure content at the displayed zoom so WebKit font metrics and line wrapping cannot clip the footer after panel scaling ([#151](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/151)).

entries: **Switch the Antigravity card between its two quota pools.** Antigravity keeps separate Gemini and Claude / GPT quotas, and the card used to show only Gemini — so anyone working mainly with Claude models in Antigravity never saw their own numbers (#150). A small tag next to the title now always names the pool on screen; tap `Gemini ⇄` to switch to `Claude / GPT ⇄` and back. The choice is remembered, the switch redraws from the last fetched snapshot without another network call, and the burn-rate forecast restarts so the two pools never blend into one prediction. It works in the 13 themes that have an Antigravity card, on macOS and Windows.

**Muse Code spending.** Muse Code's per-request tokens and cost now count toward today's cost, project totals, the HTML report, and the `usage` CLI. They are read from `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicated by record ID, and priced from LiteLLM's `meta/muse-*` entries, with `muse-spark-1.3` added to the offline fallback table. Muse keeps no local quota data, so there is no Muse quota card.
Bumped ruff to 0.16.8, `astral-sh/setup-uv` to 10.2.0, and the CodeQL actions.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 卡片支援切換兩組額度

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Antigravity 裡習慣呼叫 Claude 或 GPT 模型，以前工具卡片上永遠只顯示 Gemini 的消耗量。現在標題旁多了一個常駐標籤顯示目前的模型組別，點擊 `Gemini ⇄` 就能切換成 `Claude / GPT ⇄`，系統會記住你的選擇。切換時會直接以最近一次抓取的快照重繪畫面，完全不需再次發送網路請求，並重新啟動消耗速度預測，避免兩組額度混合計算。這項功能支援全數 13 款包含 Antigravity 卡片的主題，且在 macOS 與 Windows 上都能運作。⟦跟雙幣帳戶在手機上翻頁查帳一樣，以前只顯示台幣餘額，現在按一下就能查看外幣，切換時直接讀取剛剛的紀錄而不必重打網路，兩邊的扣款預測也不會混在一起。⟧
body.en: If you regularly use Claude or GPT models in Antigravity, tool cards previously only displayed Gemini usage. A persistent badge next to the title now shows the current model group, allowing you to click `Gemini ⇄` to switch to `Claude / GPT ⇄`, and the system remembers your choice. Switching immediately redraws the interface using the most recent snapshot without making another network request, while restarting burn rate predictions to keep both quota calculations separate. This feature supports all 13 themes containing Antigravity cards and runs on both macOS and Windows. ⟦Think of checking a mobile dual-currency account: it previously showed only the local balance, but now a single tap reveals foreign currency, directly loading recent records without new network requests and keeping deduction forecasts from mixing together.⟧

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 呼叫花費納入統計與報表
title.en: Muse Code Usage Costs Included in Statistics and Reports

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案中使用 Muse Code 輔助寫程式時，現在它產生的每筆費用都能被完整追蹤。工具會讀取 `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl` 中的工作階段紀錄，依據紀錄 ID 排除重複項目，並以每次請求消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）對照 LiteLLM 的 `meta/muse-*` 模型價格計算金額。這些花費會計入今日開銷、專案累積總計、HTML 報表與 `usage` 命令列工具。即使在斷網環境下，離線備援價目表也已補上 `muse-spark-1.3` 的計費依據。由於 Muse 本身沒有存放本機額度資料，因此不會額外提供 Muse 額度卡片。⟦好比總務人員定期整理出差單據，以前分散在各處的零星開銷無人清查，現在按紀錄編號剔除重複並對照標準價目，即便離線也有備用表可查，全數彙整到當日帳本中。⟧
body.en: When you use Muse Code to assist with coding in your projects, every expense it generates is now fully tracked. The tool reads session records in `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicates entries by record ID, and calculates costs by matching tokens consumed per request against LiteLLM `meta/muse-*` model pricing. These expenses are included in today's spending, project cumulative totals, HTML reports, and the `usage` command-line tool. Even when disconnected, the offline fallback price list includes billing rates for `muse-spark-1.3`. Because Muse does not store local quota data, no additional Muse quota card is provided. ⟦Picture an administrative clerk sorting travel receipts: previously scattered expenses went unchecked, but now duplicates are removed by record ID and matched against standard rates—with an offline backup table on hand—fully compiling everything into the daily ledger.⟧

items.original: **Muse Code spending.** Muse Code's per-request tokens and cost now count toward today's cost, project totals, the HTML report, and the `usage` CLI. They are read from `~/.local/share/muse/sessions/**/session.jsonl`, deduplicated by record ID, and priced from LiteLLM's `meta/muse-*` entries, with `muse-spark-1.3` added to the offline fallback table. Muse keeps no local quota data, so there is no Muse quota card.

entries: **Claude Code plugin: `/usage:quota`.** Run `/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage`, then `/plugin install usage@usage`, and `/usage:quota` shows how much of the Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly quota is used and when each window resets. title.zh-TW: Claude Code 新增外掛，對話中直接查額度
title.en: Claude Code Gets a Plugin for Checking Quotas Right in the Conversation

body.zh-TW:
你跟 Claude Code 對話到一半想確認還能問幾題，不必再特地跳出視窗開終端機查帳。⟦像在辦公桌邊裝了計量表，瞄一眼就知道剩餘額度，以前得特地跑去機房看總表，現在坐在位子上就能掌握。⟧只要先後安裝市集與外掛，就能依序在 Claude Code 對話介面輸入以下指令查詢：
```
/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage
/plugin install usage@usage
/usage:quota
```
執行後會列出 Claude Code 與 Codex 的 5 小時及每週額度（quota，模型使用上限）用了多少與何時重置。外掛只呼叫 `usage-cli status --json`，未安裝時會透過 `uvx` 執行。指令使用 `usage-cli` 是為避免與其他工具同名衝突，而且只有你主動輸入才會執行，Claude 絕不會在背景自行觸發。
body.en:
When you're mid-conversation with Claude Code and want to check how many questions you have left, you no longer need to jump out of the window and open a terminal to check your account. ⟦It's like having a meter installed right at your desk: one glance tells you the remaining quota. Before, you had to make a special trip to the server room to read the master gauge; now you can keep track without leaving your seat.⟧ Just install the marketplace and the plugin in order, then enter the following commands in the Claude Code conversation interface:
```
/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage
/plugin install usage@usage
/usage:quota
```
After running, it lists how much of the 5-hour and weekly quotas (the model usage limits) for Claude Code and Codex have been used and when they reset. The plugin only calls `usage-cli status --json`, and runs it via `uvx` if it isn't installed. The command uses `usage-cli` to avoid name clashes with other tools, and it only runs when you type it yourself—Claude will never trigger it on its own in the background.

items.original: **Claude Code plugin: `/usage:quota`.** Run `/plugin marketplace add aqua5230/usage`, then `/plugin install usage@usage`, and `/usage:quota` shows how much of the Claude Code and Codex 5-hour and weekly quota is used and when each window resets. The plugin only calls `usage-cli status --json` (through `uvx` when `usage-cli` isn't installed). It calls `usage-cli` rather than `usage` because other tools also install a `usage` command, and it runs only when you type it — Claude never triggers it on its own.

title.zh-TW: 狀態查詢回傳倒數秒數，免去手動換算時間
title.en: Status Queries Return Countdown Seconds, No More Manual Time Conversion

body.zh-TW: 打算寫腳本抓取帳號狀態時，串接程式再也不必為了計算剩餘時間而大費周章。⟦好比公車站牌直接標示進站倒數三分鐘，以前只印發車時刻讓乘客自己看手錶心算，現在抬頭就能直接看懂還要等多久。⟧現在執行 `usage status --json` 時，輸出格式直接替你算好倒數時間。每個統計視窗新增了 `resets_in_seconds` 欄位回傳額度重置倒數，每個代理人（agent，負責執行特定任務的 AI 程式）也多了 `age_seconds` 記錄已運作秒數。兩項數值都以報表產生的 `generated_at` 時間點為準計算完成，接收資料的下游工具不用再自己拿兩個時間戳記相減。
body.en: When you plan to write a script to pull account status, the integrating program no longer has to go to great lengths just to calculate remaining time. ⟦Think of a bus stop sign that directly shows "arriving in 3 minutes": before, it only printed departure times and passengers had to check their watches and do the math; now you just look up and immediately see how long the wait is.⟧ Now when you run `usage status --json`, the output format calculates the countdown for you. Each statistics window gains a `resets_in_seconds` field returning the countdown until the quota resets, and each agent (an AI program responsible for a specific task) also gets an `age_seconds` field recording how many seconds it has been running. Both values are computed against the report's `generated_at` timestamp, so downstream tools receiving the data no longer need to subtract two timestamps themselves.

items.original: **`usage status --json` reports countdowns.** Each window gains `resets_in_seconds` and each agent gains `age_seconds`, both measured at `generated_at`, so consumers no longer subtract timestamps themselves.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式移除過度施壓指令，交接語氣更自然
title.en: Terse Mode Drops Overly Pressuring Instructions, Making Handoffs Sound More Natural

body.zh-TW: 使用精簡模式讓 AI 長話短說時，換班交接的開場訊息不再生硬冰冷。⟦像指導實習生寫工作日誌，以前規定字字精簡且嚴禁任何問候，導致交班留言生硬冰冷，現在拿掉死板禁令，既維持精準也能在交接時保有溫暖問候。⟧系統在精簡模式（terse mode，指示 AI 保持回答簡短的設定）中移除了兩行提示詞。首先是刪去「不准淡忘」的嚴格施壓要求，因為每則訊息發送時的提醒機制本來就能穩定簡潔語氣。其次是拿掉「不要為了親切多寫」的禁令，避免它與每位使用者必讀的進度交接摘要互相衝突。
body.en: When using terse mode to make the AI keep things short, the shift-handoff opening message no longer sounds stiff and cold. ⟦Picture coaching an intern on writing a work log: the old rules demanded every word be terse and strictly banned any greeting, which made handoff notes stiff and cold. Now the rigid bans are removed, keeping things precise while still allowing a warm greeting at handoff.⟧ The system removed two lines from the prompt in terse mode (the setting that tells the AI to keep answers short). First, it deleted the strict pressuring demand to "never let it fade," because the reminder mechanism attached to every message already keeps the tone consistently concise. Second, it removed the ban on "writing extra just to be friendly," to avoid conflicting with the progress handoff summary that every user must read.

items.original: **Terse mode drops two lines.** "Never let it fade" pressure is gone — the per-message reminder already keeps the style steady — and so is "no warmth padding", which clashed with the resume handoff's warm recap, the one place every user reads.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表卡片等高對齊，手機排版補上邊界留白
title.en: HTML Report Cards Aligned to Equal Height, Mobile Layout Gains Edge Padding

body.zh-TW: 打開瀏覽器或手機查看用量報表時，畫面中的統計數據不再排列得歪歪斜斜。⟦恰似將畫廊展覽牆上的說明牌統一裁成相同尺寸，以前字數多的卡牌排版混亂且緊貼外框，現在將補充細節縮小分行並留出邊距，整面展示牆看起來整齊一致。⟧在 HTML 報表裡，四張關鍵指標卡的高度現在保持完全一致。記錄 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）消耗的卡片大字只放約略值，精確數值與漲跌幅度則改以小字分行顯示，解決了過去卡片文字換行不一的問題。手機版各區塊也在兩側補上 16px 的留白，內容不再緊貼著卡片邊界。
body.en: When you open the usage report in a browser or on your phone, the statistics on screen no longer line up crookedly. ⟦Like trimming every caption plaque on a gallery wall to the same size: before, cards with more text were laid out messily and pressed against the frame; now the supplementary details are shrunk onto separate lines with margins added, and the whole display wall looks neat and consistent.⟧ In the HTML report, the four key metric cards now all keep exactly the same height. The card tracking token (the unit of text the AI processes and bills by) consumption shows only an approximate value in large type, while the exact figure and the change move to smaller text on separate lines, fixing the old problem of inconsistent line wrapping across cards. On mobile, each section also gains 16px of padding on both sides, so content no longer hugs the card edges.

items.original: **The HTML report's KPI cards stay one height.** The big number on the tokens card shows one rounded value; the exact figure and change move to small lines, so the four cards no longer wrap unevenly. On phones, sections get 16px side padding instead of touching the card edge.

entries: **The offline price table knows Codex's GPT-6-Sol and GPT-6-Luna.** The live LiteLLM table already priced them; the built-in fallback, used only when that download fails, now carries the same prices, so spending on the two new models is not left out while offline.

**Grok's status line works on Windows.** Grok on Windows starts the whole `[ui.status_line] command` as one program path, so usage's "python.exe script.py" command failed with `os error 123`. usage now writes `~/.grok/usage-statusline-grok.cmd` and points the command at it; existing installs are switched over by the self-repair check. macOS is unchanged.

**usage no longer backs up its own older Grok status line as yours.** Setup compared the exact command, so a usage row written for another Python path was saved as the user's status line and brought back on uninstall. It now recognizes any row that points at usage's script or wrapper, and uninstall drops such a backup instead of restoring it.
**Windows first launch.** The README and website explain how to get past SmartScreen's "Windows protected your PC" prompt: More info → Run anyway.

title.zh-TW: 離線價目表補齊 GPT-6 模型，斷網也能精準記帳
title.en: Offline pricing table now covers GPT-6 models, so billing stays accurate without a network

body.zh-TW: 當你在沒有網路的環境下使用 Codex 寫程式，工具依然能準確計算最新模型的花費。線上的 LiteLLM 價目表原本就包含 GPT-6-Sol 與 GPT-6-Luna 這兩款新模型，但過去程式內建的備援（fallback，下載線上資料失敗時才會啟用的備用方案）價目表尚未更新。一旦網路斷線或是連線下載失敗，這兩個新模型的消耗金額就會漏算。現在內建備援表已經同步補上相同的價格資訊。⟦就像水電師傅隨身帶著備用紙本報價單，就算在地下室收不到訊號，翻開來照樣查得到新進特殊零件的工料費，算帳時不會漏掉任何項目。⟧
body.en: When you use Codex to write code in an environment without internet access, the tool can still accurately calculate the cost of the latest models. The online LiteLLM pricing table already included the two new models GPT-6-Sol and GPT-6-Luna, but the program's built-in fallback pricing table (the backup that only kicks in when downloading online data fails) had not been updated. Once the network dropped or the download failed, the spending on these two new models would be missed. The built-in fallback table has now been synced with the same pricing information. ⟦It is like a plumber who carries a paper backup price list: even in a basement with no signal, they can still look up the labor and material cost of newly stocked specialty parts, so nothing gets left off the bill.⟧

items.original: **The offline price table knows Codex's GPT-6-Sol and GPT-6-Luna.** The live LiteLLM table already priced them; the built-in fallback, used only when that download fails, now carries the same prices, so spending on the two new models is not left out while offline.

title.zh-TW: Grok 狀態列支援 Windows，舊設定不再誤當備份還原
title.en: Grok status line now supports Windows, and old settings are no longer mistakenly restored as backups

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Grok 搭配 usage 時，狀態列（status line，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）現在能正常運作。過去 Grok 會把 [ui.status_line] command 視為單一程式路徑而觸發 os error 123 錯誤。現在 usage 會寫入 ~/.grok/usage-statusline-grok.cmd 包裝檔並指向它，既有安裝由自我修復自動切換，macOS 維持不變。過去若 Python 路徑不同，安裝程式會把舊指令誤存為使用者設定並在移除時還原；現在只要指向 usage 腳本或包裝檔，解除安裝便會直接捨棄備份。⟦如同將工序封裝成專用料理包避免出錯，退租點交時也能認出外加包裝直接丟棄，不再誤當成原本餐具放回抽屜。⟧
body.en: When using Grok with usage on Windows, the status line (the status bar shown at the very bottom of the terminal) now works properly. Previously, Grok treated the [ui.status_line] command as a single program path, which triggered os error 123. Now usage writes a wrapper file at ~/.grok/usage-statusline-grok.cmd and points to it; existing installs switch over automatically via self-repair, while macOS stays unchanged. entries: **The menu bar app uses about half the memory and far less CPU per refresh.** Measured on one machine with 1.6 GB of Claude logs and 596 MB of Codex logs: the memory footprint went from 263 MB to about 130 MB, and each refresh from 1.2–1.65 s of CPU to 0.16–0.47 s. Grok's `updates.jsonl` lines are JSON-decoded only when they carry `costUsdTicks` (212 of 22,491 lines), and the whole Grok result is reused while none of its files change. The history cache drops lines repeated within one Claude log (57% of cached entries), shares repeated model, project and session strings, and skips entries whose source file was deleted; only the cache shards that changed are rewritten. Today's and yesterday's totals compare against local day boundaries instead of converting every entry's time zone, and the source scan groups paths by their parts. The first launch after upgrading re-reads the Claude logs once to rebuild the cache.

**Generating the HTML report again no longer re-reads every log.** The report's parsers capped their file cache at 512, below a real install's file count, so a sequential scan evicted every file; the cap is now 4096, as in the menu bar's loader. A second load went from 5.0 s to 0.1 s.

**Claude spending is no longer undercounted after the app restarts.** The on-disk cache dropped the count of 1-hour cache writes, so after a restart they were priced as 5-minute writes (1.25× input instead of 2×). `usage doctor`'s reconciliation against Claude Code's own cost went from 12% apart to 2%. The Claude cache schema was bumped, so existing caches rebuild with the right figures.

**Turning the status line off and on no longer loses the status line you had before installing usage.** The switch parked the live status line under `previousStatusLine`, the key that holds the pre-install backup, so a later uninstall had nothing to restore. It now uses its own key, and uninstalling while the switch is off restores the original too.
**Uninstalling restores the Antigravity status line.** `usage unsetup` restored Claude Code, Codex and Grok but left Antigravity pointing at usage's script.
**Several directories in `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` no longer stop the menu bar from refreshing.** The history scan assumed exactly one Claude directory and crashed when a comma-separated list named more.

**A setting changed during an update check is no longer reverted.** The background update check saved the preferences it had read before its network request, overwriting anything changed meanwhile; on macOS and Windows it now re-reads them first.

**The terse-mode and session-resume hooks' built-in fallback text matches the translations.** The fallbacks, shown only when the translation sidecar is missing, had fallen behind `i18n.json`; the English terse reminder also gets back the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped so installed copies are rewritten.
**CI checks formatting with `ruff format --check`.** The whole project was reformatted once, and that commit is listed in `.git-blame-ignore-revs`.
**The daylight-saving title test passes Windows' type check.** It calls `time.tzset` through `getattr`, since Windows has no `tzset`.

**Website on phones.** Chinese and Japanese paragraphs are no longer justified at 640px and below, the Homebrew command fits on one line in the install card, and Windows visitors see the Windows download button first.

body.zh-TW: 重啟電腦或重新打開 usage 後，你看到的 Claude 花費不會再少算。以前程式將資料寫入硬碟快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，漏掉了「1 小時快取寫入」的筆數。這導致 App 重開後，這批寫入被誤當成費率較低的 5 分鐘快取計價（以輸入價格的 1.25 倍而非正確的 2 倍計算），算出來的花費因而偏低。用 `usage doctor` 跟 Claude Code 自己算的花費對帳，差距從 12% 降到 2%。Claude 的快取結構已升級，現有快取會以正確的倍率重新計算。⟦就像飯店櫃台的電腦重開機後，以前會把住一晚的客人誤登成鐘點休息，帳因此少算一截；現在重開機也會照原本登記的方案收費。⟧
body.en: After restarting your computer or reopening usage, the Claude spending you see is no longer undercounted. Previously, when writing data to disk cache, the program dropped the count of "1-hour cache writes". Reconciling with `usage doctor` against Claude Code's own cost figures, the gap went from 12% to 2%. The Claude cache structure was upgraded, so existing caches recalculate with the correct multiplier. ⟦It is like a hotel front-desk system that, after a reboot, used to log overnight guests as short hourly stays and undercharge them; now it keeps charging the plan each guest actually booked.⟧

The Claude cache schema was bumped, so existing caches rebuild with the right figures.

title.zh-TW: 解除安裝完整還原原本的狀態列，開關切換不再覆寫原始備份

body.zh-TW: 你在安裝 usage 之前自己設定的狀態列，現在不會再被弄丟。以前在設定中關閉再開啟狀態列，程式會把當前的狀態列暫存在專門保存安裝前備份的欄位 `previousStatusLine`，導致原本的舊設定被蓋掉，日後解除安裝時找不到最初的設定值。現在開關改用獨立欄位儲存，即使在狀態列關閉的狀態下解除安裝，也能順利找回原本的設定。執行 `usage unsetup` 解除安裝時，除了還原 Claude Code、Codex 與 Grok 之外，現在也會一併還原 Antigravity 的狀態列，不再將其遺留在 usage 的腳本捷徑上。⟦租車出遊換上自己的導航架，還車拆下時車行依舊把原廠螢幕接回，不會因為中途切換過模式就弄丟原本的配備。⟧
body.en: The status line you set up before installing usage is no longer lost. Previously, toggling the status line off and on in settings caused the program to park the active status line under `previousStatusLine`, a field reserved for the pre-installation backup, which overwrote the original configuration and left uninstallation with nothing to restore. Toggling now stores state in an independent field, successfully restoring your original settings even if you uninstall while the status line is turned off. When running `usage unsetup` to uninstall, in addition to restoring Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, it now also restores Antigravity's status line instead of leaving it pointing at usage's script shortcut. ⟦Picture installing your own navigation mount in a rental car; when returning the car and taking it down, the agency still hooks the factory screen back up without losing the original gear just because you switched modes during the trip.⟧

title.zh-TW: 支援多個 Claude 目錄掃描，修復背景更新覆寫設定與 Hook 備援文字

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時會在多個環境目錄切換，或習慣一邊檢查軟體更新一邊調整偏好，日常操作現在更加穩定順手。當你在環境變數 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 中用逗號指定多個資料夾時，歷史紀錄掃描不再因預設單一路徑而當掉，選單列能持續正常刷新。背景檢查更新時，程式在連網結束後會先重新讀取最新的設定檔，解決 macOS 與 Windows 上剛改好的設定會被連網前的舊資料覆蓋回去的問題。精簡模式與接續工作階段的 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）在遺失翻譯檔時顯示的內建備援文字，已同步至最新 `i18n.json` 內容。英文精簡提醒也補回「Drop filler … and pleasantries」的動詞。兩支 hook 均已升級版本並會自動重寫本機副本。多專案切換與自訂偏好設定的使用者，從此不必再擔心設定被莫名還原或畫面停止更新。
body.en: If you frequently switch between multiple environment directories or adjust preferences while checking for software updates, daily workflows are now smoother and more reliable. When you specify multiple folders separated by commas in the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable, history scans no longer crash by assuming a single path, allowing the menu bar to refresh normally. During background update checks, the program now re-reads the latest preferences after the network request finishes, fixing an issue on macOS and Windows where freshly updated settings were overwritten by stale pre-network data. The built-in fallback text shown by terse-mode and session-resume hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) when translation files are missing has been synchronized with the latest `i18n.json`. The English terse reminder also restores the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped and will automatically rewrite local copies. Users switching across projects and customizing preferences no longer need to worry about settings unexpectedly reverting or displays freezing.

body.zh-TW: 用手機瀏覽 usage 官方網站，或是在不同作業系統參與專案開發時，閱讀與測試體驗都更為清爽。官網在 640px 以下的手機螢幕上，中日文段落取消了兩端對齊排版，讓窄螢幕閱讀更自然。安裝卡片內的 Homebrew 安裝指令現在能完整在一行內放下，而 Windows 訪客打開首頁時也會優先看到專屬的下載按鈕。在內部維護方面，持續整合（CI，自動驗證程式碼的機制）導入了 `ruff format --check` 檢查程式碼排版，全專案重排的紀錄也已收錄在 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 中，讓 `git blame` 不會把每一行都算到這次重排頭上。夏令時間標題測試改用 `getattr` 呼叫 `time.tzset`，順利解決 Windows 系統因缺乏該函式而無法通過型別檢查的困擾。

On mobile screens at 640px and below, the website removes justified text alignment for Chinese and Japanese paragraphs, making narrow-screen reading more natural. The Homebrew install command inside the install card now fits cleanly on a single line, and Windows visitors opening the homepage see the dedicated Windows download button first. For internal maintenance, continuous integration (CI, an automated mechanism for verifying code) introduced `ruff format --check` to verify code formatting, and the commit for reformatting the entire project is recorded in `.git-blame-ignore-revs` so `git blame` does not attribute every line to that reformat. The daylight-saving title test now calls `time.tzset` via `getattr`, resolving type-checking failures on Windows due to the missing function.

entries: **New app icon: a flat ink-wash cat.** Every icon is now generated from one set of SVG sources in `assets/brand/` (color, black, reversed, wordmark, app icon) by `scripts/make_app_icon.py`: the macOS and Windows app icons, the README avatar, the website favicon, apple-touch-icon and logo banner. body.zh-TW: 平時使用 Claude Code 呼叫最新的預設模型，現在離線也能算出正確花費。從 Claude Code 2.1.280 開始，Opus 5.5（`claude-opus-5-5`）已成為預設的 Opus 模型。然而先前的離線備援價目表遺漏了這筆資料，導致價格快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）一旦過期，該模型的花費就會被錯誤算成 $0。現在價目表已補上每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入 $4、輸出 $20、快取寫入 $5 與快取讀取 $0.20 的定價，標準與 LiteLLM 完全一致。用量報表中的欄位也改為直接顯示「Opus 5.5」，不再印出冗長的原始識別碼。⟦計程車跳表機預載了最新的夜間加成費率表，就算開進收不到訊號的地下道，也能照常按新費率精準計費。⟧
body.en: Calling the latest default model in Claude Code now computes accurate costs even offline. Since Claude Code 2.1.280, Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) has been the default Opus model. However, the previous offline fallback price table omitted this entry, causing the model's cost to be wrongly calculated as $0 whenever the price cache expired. The price table now includes pricing of $4 input, $20 output, $5 cache writes, and $0.20 cache reads per million tokens, matching LiteLLM exactly. Columns in usage reports also directly display "Opus 5.5" instead of printing the lengthy raw identifier. ⟦Like a taxi meter preloaded with the latest night-surcharge rates, pricing remains accurate even when driving into an underpass with no signal.⟧

items.original: **Opus 5.5 has an offline price and a short name.** Claude Code 2.1.280 made Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default Opus model, but the fallback price table had no entry for it, so whenever the price cache had expired its usage was costed at $0. The table now carries $4/$20 per Mtok with $5 cache writes and $0.20 cache reads, matching LiteLLM, and the usage table shows "Opus 5.5" instead of the raw model ID.

title.zh-TW: Grok 缺少總紀錄檔時，各工作階段花費照常自動補回
title.en: Grok per-session spending is recovered automatically when combined log is missing

body.zh-TW: 查詢 Grok 的使用花費時，就算總紀錄檔尚未建立也不必擔心資料遺失。在先前的機制中，當總彙整檔 `unified.jsonl` 不存在時，系統會直接回傳空清單，導致個別工作階段在 `updates.jsonl` 裡記錄的花費跟著全部丟失。現在程式會將「檔案不存在」比照「檔案內容為空」來處理，照常從各工作階段的日誌中將花費完整補回，確保統計數據不會漏算。⟦抄表員發現社區總電表尚未安裝，便逐一抄下各分戶的獨立電表，依然能把整棟樓的用電度數完整拼湊回來。⟧
body.en: Checking Grok spending no longer risks losing data even if the combined log has not been created yet. Under the previous mechanism, when the combined log file `unified.jsonl` did not exist, the system returned an empty list, causing all spending recorded by individual sessions in `updates.jsonl` to be lost. The program now treats a non-existent file the same as an empty file, fully recovering spending from individual session logs as usual and ensuring statistics are never undercounted. ⟦Picture a meter reader who discovers the building's master electric meter is not yet installed and reads each individual apartment meter instead, completely piecing together the power usage.⟧

items.original: **Grok spending is recovered when `unified.jsonl` is missing.** A missing combined log returned an empty list, so the per-session `updates.jsonl` spending was dropped too. It is now handled like an empty combined log and recovered as before.

title.zh-TW: 官網新增首次安裝指引，校正中日韓文字排版與動態細節
title.en: Website adds first-launch guide, CJK typography fixes, and animated details

body.zh-TW: 造訪 usage 官網時，現在能看到更清晰的指引與細緻動態。安裝區說明 macOS 15 起無法以右鍵打開繞過 Gatekeeper，需至「系統設定」→「隱私權與安全性」點選「強制打開」，首頁下載鈕下方與五份 README 同步附上說明。GitHub 按鈕顯示即時星星數，抓取失敗時自動隱藏，標題補上 Grok。主題截圖改 WebP（英文頁 647KB 降至 95KB），非英文頁的 JSON-LD 帶入專屬網址、語言與描述。中日韓頁依 W3C clreq 校正：標題字距歸零、中文標題僅在詞間斷行、破折號不落行首，安裝卡文字與行距放大，首屏說明改回一般斷行以消除兩端對齊拉出的過大空隙，英文頁不變。頁首紅圈載入時一筆畫出並隨閱讀縮短，複製成功補滿小紅圈，首屏標題後方有淡紅圈旋轉，並新增五語 404 頁；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下所有動畫關閉。
body.en: Visiting the usage website now presents clearer guidance and refined animations. The install section explains that from macOS 15 onward, right-click Open no longer bypasses Gatekeeper, requiring users to go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway; these instructions are linked below the hero download button and across all five READMEs. The GitHub button shows a live star count and automatically hides if fetching fails, with Grok added to titles. Theme screenshots switch to WebP (dropping from 647KB to 95KB on the English page), and non-English pages populate their own URL, language, and description in JSON-LD. CJK pages follow W3C clreq corrections: heading letter-spacing is zeroed, Chinese headings break only between words, em dashes never start a line, install card text and line height are enlarged, and hero text reverts to standard line breaks to eliminate oversized gaps caused by justified alignment, leaving English pages unchanged. The header's red circle draws in on load and shrinks as you scroll down, the copy button fills in a small red circle on success, a faint red circle rotates behind the hero title, and new 404 pages cover five languages; all animations are disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

items.original:
**Website: first-launch guide and live star count.** The install section explains what to do when macOS blocks the first launch (from macOS 15, right-click → Open no longer bypasses Gatekeeper; use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway), linked from under the hero download button, and all five READMEs describe the same steps. The Star on GitHub button shows the live star count and hides it if the request fails. Titles mention Grok, theme screenshots are WebP (647KB → 95KB on the English page), and non-English pages carry their own URL, language and description in JSON-LD.
**Website: CJK typography follows W3C clreq.** Chinese, Japanese and Korean pages use zero heading letter-spacing, break Chinese headings only between words, keep em dashes off the start of a line, and use larger text and line height in the install cards. Justified paragraphs were reverted to normal line breaking after they opened wide gaps in the hero text. English pages are unchanged.
**Website: the logo's red circle animates.** In the header it draws in on load and shrinks as you read down the page, the copy button closes its small circle on success, a faint large circle turns behind the hero title, and a new 404 page switches among the five languages. All motion is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

entries: **The HTML report is laid out as dashboard cards.** Each section sits in a card of the same shape instead of being split by thin rules, which were hard to follow down a long page. Body text and numbers share one sans-serif face with tabular figures; monospace is kept for the `[usage]>` prefix and the command line at the top. The palette is neutral, token counts are no longer amber, and green is kept for trends and peaks. The four summary cards share one three-row grid, so their numbers line up.

**Chart labels in the HTML report are larger.** Axis labels went from 9px to 12px and legends from .7rem to .8rem, and the hour axis and the heatmap's month and weekday labels grew with them. The old sizes were unreadable on an ordinary screen.

**Switching Claude accounts no longer shows the previous account's quota on Windows.** Claude Code tags the quota it caches in `~/.claude.json` with the account that fetched it and ignores the cache after a switch. usage did not check the tag, and on Windows that cache is the main source of Claude quota. A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

**Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

**Website visual refresh.** The feature section alternates image and text in three rows (quota for every tool, the HTML report, themes) with the remaining features as two-column cards, and the standalone report section merged into the second row. The pacing section is a paper card, the theme preview sizes its frame to the panel so short panels leave no empty space, and install moved to the end. Nav links, the mobile copy button and footer links have larger tap targets, and panel previews show a static poster until they load, in Chinese on the Chinese pages.

title.en: The HTML report gets a new layout, with chart text up from 9px to 12px

body.zh-TW: 打開 usage 產出的 HTML 報表，現在每個區塊都收進外框一致的儀表板卡片裡。以前整頁報表只靠細線分段，頁面一長很難看清哪裡是哪裡；現在上方四張摘要卡共用同一個三列格線，數字整齊切齊。內文與數值一律換成無襯線字體配等寬數字，等寬字體只留給頂部的指令與 `[usage]>` 前綴。整體色調轉為中性，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量不再是土黃色，綠色則專門留給趨勢與尖峰。圖表上的文字也同步變大，坐標軸標籤從 9px 放大到 12px、圖例從 .7rem 放大到 .8rem，時段軸與熱力圖的月份及星期標籤都變大了，解決以前在普通螢幕上看不清的困擾。⟦就像展覽的導覽手冊，以前整本只用幾條細線隔開長篇文字，現在改成一張張分好類的解說牌，字也印大了，站遠一點也看得清。⟧

title.zh-TW: Windows 上切換 Claude 帳號不再殘留前一個人的額度
title.en: Switching Claude accounts on Windows no longer shows previous quota

body.zh-TW: 家裡或公司共用一台 Windows 電腦，各自登入不同的 Claude 帳號？Claude Code 會把查到的用量額度存在 `~/.claude.json` 檔案中，並在快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）裡標註抓取時的帳號名稱；只要一換帳號，Claude Code 就會自動忽略該筆暫存。以前 usage 讀取檔案時沒有檢查這個帳號標籤，而 Windows 上查詢 Claude 額度又主要仰賴這份快取，才導致換了帳號卻依然顯示前一位使用者的剩餘用量。現在只要發現帳號不符就會主動跳過該快取；至於舊版 Claude Code 寫入、沒有帶帳號標籤的快取資料，依然會正常讀取。⟦像到洗衣店取件，店員會先核對單據上的名字，名字不是你，就不會把上一位客人的衣服交給你。⟧
body.en: Sharing one Windows PC and signing in to different Claude accounts? Claude Code stores retrieved quota in `~/.claude.json` and tags the cache (temporary storage for fetched results) with the account name that retrieved it, automatically ignoring the cache whenever the account switches. Previously, usage did not verify this account tag, and Windows relies primarily on this cache file for Claude quota, causing the tool to keep displaying the previous user's remaining balance after a switch. Now, any cache with a mismatched account is skipped; caches written by older Claude Code versions without account tags continue to be read normally. ⟦Picture a dry cleaner who checks the name on every ticket, so you never walk out with the previous customer's clothes.⟧

A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

title.zh-TW: 報表測試時間一律固定為 UTC，排除時區不同造成的驗證失敗
title.en: Report tests pin session start times to UTC to avoid time zone failures

body.zh-TW: 這是給開發者的修正，一般使用者不會感覺到差別。以前有 6 支報表測試只能在時區設為 UTC 的電腦上通過，導致線上持續整合（CI，自動驗證程式的機制）明明是綠燈，開發者在 UTC+8 的 Windows 電腦上跑測試卻固定失敗。這是因為程式先前直接在行內轉換工作階段的開始時間，測試環境沒辦法把時間固定住；現在這段時間轉換邏輯獨立了出來，讓測試能把時間基準牢牢鎖在 UTC，軟體本身的功能與行為則完全維持不變。⟦跨國線上大考一律以格林威治標準時間出題與收卷，不再拿各地考生的手錶時間當標準，評分就不會因為考生住在不同時區而判錯。⟧
body.en: This one is for developers; as a user you won't notice a difference. Previously, 6 report tests passed only on machines configured for the UTC time zone, so continuous integration (CI) stayed green while tests consistently failed on Windows machines in UTC+8. This happened because the code converted session start times inline where test fixtures could not freeze the clock; that conversion logic is now separated out so tests can pin the reference time directly to UTC, while the software's functional behavior remains completely unchanged. ⟦An international exam that syncs every clock to GMT grades everyone against the same time, not against each student's wristwatch.⟧

items.original: **Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

title.zh-TW: 官網視覺排版重整，手機更好點按並加入面板預載圖
title.en: Website visual redesign with larger tap targets and preloaded panel posters

body.zh-TW: 逛 usage 官方網站時，現在用手機點選連結或按鈕順手多了。首頁功能區改用三排圖文左右交錯呈現，分別介紹各工具額度、HTML 報表與外觀主題，其餘功能則整理成雙欄卡片，原本獨立的報表區塊也直接併入第二排。進度管家改採紙卡質感呈現，主題預覽外框會跟著面板高度自動縮放，短面板下方不再留下一大塊尷尬空白，安裝教學則移到頁面最下方。⟦翻開重新裝訂的產品型錄，主力商品圖文並茂排在最前頭，其餘項目整齊收進小格子，按鈕也加大防誤觸，讀起來清爽多了。⟧頂部導覽列、手機複製按鈕與頁尾連結都放大了點擊有效範圍，而且面板預覽在載入完成前會先顯示靜態預載海報，中文網頁也配上中文版海報。
body.en: Browsing the usage official website on a mobile phone is now much easier on your fingers.
